summary.zh: Bisht 报告记载北门一带大号印度河文字符号（含约十字符号铭文等）；文字仍未破译——符号存在是事实，读法是假说。
summary.en: Bisht report documents large Indus-script signs (including a ~ten-sign inscription near the north gate). Script remains undeciphered — existence is fact; readings are hypotheses.
